caseName: Uniroyal Englebert Belgique, S. A. v. Connelly
caseNameFull: Uniroyal Englebert Belgique, S. A. v. Connelly

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. Ill. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
